scenarios.title: 2002-era 3211/3212/3213 classification
scenarios.setup: For a historical date in the 2002-era release, account 3211 means commercial discount, not the 2015 healthy short-term loan category.
scenarios.expected: Return versioned historical meaning and citation; do not remap a posted journal.

scenarios.title: 2015 short-term credit account re-use
scenarios.setup: For an institution-approved post-2015 chart, 321 is healthy short-term credit and 322 sensitive short-term credit.
scenarios.expected: Require approved release/effective date; never infer current 2026 approval from source alone.

scenarios.title: 2015 article 8(d) 312/322 inconsistency
scenarios.setup: A proposed sensitive short-term loan mapping relies on the printed 312 header but 322 child codes.
scenarios.expected: Quarantine mapping pending authoritative clarification; no posting.

scenarios.title: 2003 2651/2652 semantic collision
scenarios.setup: Two instruments assign conflicting public/private meanings to 2651 and 2652.
scenarios.expected: Require explicit effective-dated supersession and institution approval; preserve original evidence.

scenarios.title: Legacy 459 branch clearing notification
scenarios.setup: An internal 'avis de sort' is received but independent external settlement evidence is absent.
scenarios.expected: Record internal resolution evidence only; prohibit SETTLED/FINAL external status and customer balance mutation.

scenarios.title: Legacy 999 unmatched computer posting
scenarios.setup: An unmatched imported record is proposed for 999 off-balance suspense.
scenarios.expected: Quarantine operationally, log ownership and SLA; do not manufacture a balancing posting or treat 999 as settlement.

scenarios.title: Replay of legacy branch transfer
scenarios.setup: Same branch clearing notice is ingested twice with same source key.
scenarios.expected: Deduplicate; no second posting or clearing release; preserve replay audit.

scenarios.title: 2002 correspondent rating attribute
scenarios.setup: Historical COBAC rating 1–4 is read as though it were the current rating taxonomy.
scenarios.expected: Require rating scheme/version/effective date and evidence; block unsupported current prudential inference.

scenarios.title: Inventory accounting on non-authorized bank
scenarios.setup: A bank without verified authorization attempts to activate 473/640/740 merchandise workflows.
scenarios.expected: Deny; keep historical chart available only for research and licensed applicable profiles.

scenarios.title: Historical report reconstruction
scenarios.setup: Produce a 2003 as-filed report after a 2015 chart update.
scenarios.expected: Reproduce original code meaning and posted journal IDs; do not rewrite immutable history.

scenarios.title: Correction after period closure
scenarios.setup: Historical mapping error identified in a closed period.
scenarios.expected: Require formal approval and new correction/reversal entries and report versioning; never edit posted rows.

scenarios.title: Incomplete source custody
scenarios.setup: A proposed chart release relies only on web screenshots, no retained source binary or signed institution interpretation.
scenarios.expected: Keep RESEARCH_ONLY and block activation; record evidence custody limitation.

scenarios.title: Unknown external outcome
scenarios.setup: An outbound branch/correspondent operation times out after dispatch.
scenarios.expected: Remain UNKNOWN/RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED, not failed/succeeded by assumption; retry idempotently.

scenarios.title: Independent regulatory reporting check
scenarios.setup: An account is reclassified between 2002 and 2015 versions.
scenarios.expected: Reconcile old/new account totals with signed bridge and independent review; zero unexplained residual.
